title: Faithful linear and relational representations of diagram categories and monoids
summary: We study representations of diagram categories by binary relations and matrices over rings and semirings. Our main result is a faithful involutive tensor representation of the partition category $P$ (and consequently of each partition monoid $P_n$) by zero-one matrices over an arbitrary (additively) idempotent semiring. The dimensions of the matrices involved are powers of $2$, and we show that these are minimal with respect to faithful involutive tensor representations by matrices over any semiring.
